name: Moonlit Meadow
why: A counting bedtime song lives in one glowing night world a toddler can name: five coloured fireflies, a smiling moon, and stars that were once fireflies — light itself is the story, which is exactly what pixel-by-pixel painting does best.
look: Deep blue night painted in light: soft gradient sky, twinkling stars, rolling hills, swaying grass blades, a big smiling moon with blush cheeks; five round firefly characters (yellow, mint, pink, sky, lilac) with big sparkly eyes and glowing tails. Numbers appear as chunky glowing Fredoka digits.
elements: five firefly characters with faces and glowing tails
a smiling moon that wakes and sleeps
motion: Everything bobs and glows; fireflies hop up-up-up on the words, tails pulse on every 'blink', hard cuts between camera framings of one continuous world.
